purpose.zh: 练髋部末端伸展，适合久坐和劈叉后腿
purpose.en: Train end-range hip extension for sitters and the back leg of the splits.

text.zh: 夹紧臀部把大腿抬离地面，腰不拱
text.en: Squeeze your glute to lift the thigh off the floor without arching your back

text.zh: 俯卧，一侧膝盖弯曲90度，脚底朝天
text.en: Lie face down with one knee bent to 90 degrees, sole to the ceiling.

text.zh: 只抬起几厘米，停2秒再慢慢放下
text.en: Lift just a few centimetres, hold for two seconds, then lower slowly.

commonErrors.zh: 用腰拱起代替臀部发力
commonErrors.en: Arching the lower back instead of using the glute.
Letting one side of the pelvis lift.

cautions.zh: 腰部疼痛时减小抬腿高度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Lift lower if your lower back hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
